name: Expose compat timing and smoke interpretation
intent: Evaluate preserving r3 lookup timing under once-only early inheritance, and provide a PID-scoped diagnostic readout without turning optional unavailability into smoke failure or success.
must: Preserve accepted host65ac5089 and audit manifest37c48e2b/inputs a825ba23; do not rebuild, deploy, take a device lock or modify U10.1/T8.
Use actual accepted source and hash-bound raw artifact/gate evidence, not a proxy library or an invented approval.
Unavailable optional compat is diagnostic, neither smoke failure by itself nor proof of success; fingerprints, required owners, controls and screenshot decisions remain independent.
Produce proposed registry deltas only; never edit the live exception registry or approve the new N1 observation.
All cited evidence paths must exist in this worktree or already-landed master; no user-home paths in landing files.
decisions: Replay the actual r3 and accepted N11h callbacks with compat becoming mapped during bootstrap; keep this explicitly a simulated loader counterexample, not a device measurement.
Retain accepted bytes when zero-delta late lookup cannot select an earlier conditional whitelist without granting unverified permissions or repeating inheritance.
Knowledge smoke entry is a readout rule, not an activation_smoke spec; the current mandatory U10 marker must not be inherited into a final N11h smoke unmodified.
Require target PID; missing, mixed, malformed and declared skipped-branch observations do not become compat success.
out_of_scope: No production smoke runner change, executable window, dynamic single-owner proof or screenshot signoff.
